description: Source code for the InputManager class in Android's input system, managing input dispatching, reading, processing, and related IPC interfaces.

classes.name: InputManager
classes.description: Manages input dispatching, reading, processing, and IPC communication in Android.

methods.name: InputManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing input dispatcher, processor, blocker, and reader.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts input dispatcher and reader threads.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops input dispatcher and reader threads.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns reference to the input reader interface.

methods.name: getProcessor
methods.description: Returns reference to the input processor interface.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns reference to the input dispatcher interface.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the state of input components into a string.

methods.name: createInputChannel
methods.description: Creates an input channel over IPC, restricted to shell/root UIDs.

methods.name: removeInputChannel
methods.description: Removes an input channel identified by connection token.

methods.name: setFocusedWindow
methods.description: Sets the focused window for input dispatching.
